title: Raku Firing Workshop
host_org: Arkansas Museum of Fine Arts (Windgate Art School)
source_quote: Learn all about the basics of raku firing! Two pieces of pottery will be provided for you to decorate, glaze, and fire.
how_to_join: Register online; open to adults of all skill levels
summary: One-day raku workshop at the Windgate Art School: decorate, glaze and fire two pieces. Experienced students can bring their own bisqueware.
evidence_sentence: Open to anyone: you decorate, glaze and fire your own raku pieces.
evidence_quote: Learn all about the basics of raku firing!
